name: Nara Wildmane
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Nara Wildmane helps the Horde grasp the danger in the Wailing Caverns. Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem saw corruption in the Emerald Dream but could not endure it, so he sent travelers to his young disciple. Nara saw the nightmare taking hold of their kin.

sections.title: A Vision of Corruption
sections.body:
Unnatural signs spread across the Barrens, and Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem entered the Emerald Dream to find their cause. There he found a druidic cult that had once hoped to restore life to the dry savannah. A vile taint had driven its members mad.

Age kept Hamuul from enduring the nightmare’s assault, so he fled to the waking world. His younger disciple, Nara Wildmane, refused to leave so soon. Her fierce resolve kept her in the dreamscape, where she saw the transformed cult for herself.

sections.title: Confronting the Nightmare
sections.body: Nara Wildmane knows what the fallen druids have done and what they mean to unleash upon Kalimdor. When she saw them in the Emerald Dream, their faces were twisted and scaled like serpents. Hamuul guides the Cenarion Circle from Thunder Bluff, while Nara brings the knowledge needed to fight the corruption. Now the Horde strikes into the Wailing Caverns to destroy the leaders who forsook their sacred oaths.

faq.answer: Nara Wildmane is a young tauren druid who lives on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She studies under Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem and faces the nightmares corrupting nature.

faq.q: Why does Hamuul Runetotem send travelers to speak with her?
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem sends travelers to Nara because age and failing strength kept him from remaining in the corrupted dream. Young and fiercely determined, Nara stayed longer and learned of the Druids of the Fang and their plans.

faq.q: What did Nara see in the Emerald Dream?
faq.answer: Nara saw the fallen druids dwelling in the Wailing Caverns. Their faces had become scaled and serpentine, and she learned of their crimes and dark plots against the Barrens.

faq.q: Where can Nara Wildmane be found?
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane can be found in a druidic tent atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, across from Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Nara Wildmane?
aliases: what does nara want me to do
leaders of the fang follow up
faq.answer: After you speak with Nara, she directs you into the Wailing Caverns to slay the rogue Druids of the Fang. This leads to the larger undertaking called Leaders of the Fang.

faq.q: Why are the druids in the Wailing Caverns corrupted?
aliases: druids of the fang why evil
faq.answer: Led by Naralex, the druids entered the caverns hoping to draw on the Emerald Dream and bring lush life to the Barrens. Naralex’s slumber became a horrific nightmare that ensnared his followers and twisted them into the serpentine Druids of the Fang.

angles.text: As a tauren who has recently taken up druidism under Hamuul, you are part of a young generation willing to face unnatural blight, as Nara is.
As a druid, you can admire Nara’s courage in the corrupted reaches of the Emerald Dream, where even the veteran Hamuul could not linger.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how Nara’s watchfulness guards its heartland against the dark energies twisting the Barrens and threatening to spread into Mulgore.
